import cv2,numpy as np
from scipy.signal import find_peaks,peak_widths
from scipy.ndimage import gaussian_filter1d
im=cv2.imread('terminal/tasks/fishFry/pizza_screen_minus01_centered_1448x1448_rotated_cw0p5_clean_upper_right_724x724_arrow_removed_opencv_base.png',0)
assert im.shape==(724,724)
for name,(x0,y0,x1,y1) in [('A',(65,220,420,540)),('B',(65,350,400,660)),('C',(170,330,465,610)),('D',(40,200,380,650))]:
 gray=im[y0:y1,x0:x1].astype(float)
 yy,xx=np.indices(gray.shape,dtype=float);xx+=x0; yy+=y0
 print('REGION',name,'IMAGE',gray.shape,flush=True)
 for theta in [140,141,141.5,142,142.5,143,144]:
  a=np.radians(theta);norm=-np.sin(a)*xx+np.cos(a)*yy
  idx=np.floor(norm).astype(int);idx-=idx.min();n=int(idx.max())+1
  counts=np.bincount(idx.ravel(),minlength=n)
  mean=np.bincount(idx.ravel(),weights=(255-gray).ravel(),minlength=n)/np.maximum(counts,1)
  sm=gaussian_filter1d(mean,0.6);resid=sm-gaussian_filter1d(sm,13)
  valid=counts>=120
  res=np.where(valid,resid,-1000)
  peaks,_=find_peaks(res,prominence=5,distance=9)
  peaks=peaks[(peaks>8)&(peaks<n-8)]
  gap=np.diff(peaks)
  width=peak_widths(res,peaks,rel_height=.5)[0] if len(peaks)>2 else np.array([])
  maxr=float(np.max(res[valid])) if np.any(valid) else None
  print('THETA',theta,'COUNTVALID',int(valid.sum()),'PEAKS',len(peaks),'MEDIAN',float(np.median(gap)) if len(gap) else None,'GAPS',gap[:32].tolist(),'WIDTHS_MED',round(float(np.median(width)),2) if len(width) else None,'STD',round(float(np.std(res[valid])),2) if np.any(valid) else None,'MAX',round(maxr,2) if maxr else None,flush=True)
